title: eCommerce Customer Success Executive
description:
About Ricoh
A global leader in digital services, recognised for innovation, sustainability and a people-first culture. We feature in the Gartner Magic Quadrant, are listed in the Global 100 Most Sustainable Companies, and have been named one of Forbes' World's Best Employers 2025.

At Ricoh, we believe people do their best work when they feel valued and supported. We create inclusive workplaces where you can grow, contribute, and make a positive impact while helping to build a more sustainable future.

Find your place. Transform your future

Our purpose is centred on understanding and improving how people work. By focusing on real working experiences, we support individuals to develop their skills, realise their potential and do work that feels meaningful.

People transform when they Love What They Do

This belief sits at the heart of The Ricoh Promise. It guides how we recruit, how we support our people, and how we work together every day, creating an environment where you can grow, feel valued and make a difference.

When you join us, you are encouraged to share your ideas, challenge the way things are done, and work with others to build something better. If you are looking for a place where your voice is heard, your development is supported, and your work feels meaningful, you will feel at home at Ricoh.

What you will be doing
As an eCommerce Customer Success Executive, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the success and growth of both The Ricoh eShop (TReS) and the One Ricoh Portal (ORP). You'll be responsible for delivering an exceptional online experience, driving customer engagement, and supporting internal teams to maximise digital sales and service excellence.

The successful candidate will act as a key contact for customers both internal and external ensuring platforms remain accurate, functional, and aligned with customer needs whilst supporting the wider eCommerce strategy.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Management
- Manage and maintain Tres & ORP to ensure accuracy and a seamless customer experience
- Configure products, pricing, catalogues, user access, and approval workflows.
- Create and implement platform updates and enhancements based on customer requirements.
- Conduct regular audits to ensure platform data is current and compliant with business standards.

Customer Support
- Act as a primary point of contact for Tres and ORP related queries and issues.
- Investigate and resolve incidents within agreed service levels.
- Provide guidance and training to internal and external customers on platform functionality and best practices.

Operational Excellence
- Monitor platform performance and user activity.
- Identify process improvements to enhance customer experience and internal efficiency.
- Support testing and implementation of new functionality, system upgrades, and releases.
- Maintain accurate documentation of platform configurations and procedures.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
- Work closely with Sales, Customer Services, IT, Supply Chain, and Product Marketing teams.
- Support onboarding of new customers onto the eCommerce platforms.
- Participate in customer meetings and project activities as required.
- Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure solutions meet both customer and business requirements.

Data & Reporting
- Produce and maintain reports on platform usage, customer activity, and revenue
- Analyse trends and recommend actions to improve engagement and adoption.
- Support KPI tracking and continuous improvement initiatives.

You will ideally have
Essential
- Experience working within an eCommerce, customer service, or digital support environment.
- Strong customer focus with excellent communication skills.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently.
- Excellent attention to detail and problem-solving abilities.
- Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel.

Desirable
- Experience managing B2 B eCommerce platforms.
- Experience with customer onboarding and training.
- Understanding of data analysis and reporting (Power BI preferred)
- Experience working with CRM systems.

Personal Attributes
- Customer-centric mindset.
- Proactive and results oriented.
- Strong organisational skills.
- Excellent stakeholder management abilities.
- Adaptable and willing to learn new technologies.
- Collaborative team player with a positive attitude.

In return for your commitment, you can expect
At Ricoh, work should feel meaningful, supportive and fulfilling. The Ricoh Promise shapes your experience through four pillars that bring our culture to life.
Love to Connect

You become part of a global community built on openness, inclusion and genuine collaboration.
Across teams, countries and roles, you'll find people who listen, involve and encourage you - helping you feel valued and able to be yourself every day.
Love to Grow

Your development truly matters to us. With access to learning pathways, mentoring and career opportunities across functions and countries, you'll be supported to stretch your skills, explore new directions and stay future-ready in a changing world.
Love to Give Back

Purpose is part of how we work. You'll have opportunities to make a difference through volunteering, sustainability initiatives and community programmes that reflect our shared values and commitment to positive impact.
Love to Succeed

Success at Ricoh is something we pursue together. You'll benefit from fair rewards, flexible working, wellbeing resources and real recognition - including programmes such as the Imagine. Change. Awards, where colleagues celebrate each other's achievements.
We are an equal opportunities employer
We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger, and we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Our hiring decisions are based on skills, experience and potential, and we are committed to creating a fair and inclusive recruitment process. If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment journey, please let us know and we will support you to bring your best self forward.

Ready to love what you do? Apply now and help us shape what comes next.

title: Local Marketing Manager
description:
At Howdens, we're looking for a creative Local Marketing Manager to join us on an initial 12-month fixed-term contract. Supporting our network of over 950 depots, you'll lead the delivery of impactful local marketing activity that drives brand awareness, customer engagement and sales. From developing marketing toolkits and managing local campaigns to supporting new depot openings and major business initiatives, you'll work closely with stakeholders across the business to ensure marketing activations are delivered effectively, measured successfully and aligned with our wider commercial objectives.

This role is based in at our office in Raunds, Northamptonshire and the team work on site 4 days a week.

What will I be doing?
- Support depots and trade teams with on-the-ground marketing that drives local awareness, engagement, and sales.
- Manage and continuously improve our Depot Marketing Toolkit, leading projects and working with stakeholders to ensure it meets evolving business needs.
- Provide end-to-end marketing support for new depot openings, relocations, refurbishments and closures, collaborating closely with depot managers and regional stakeholders.
- Lead the planning and delivery of depot point-of-sale (POS) activity, ensuring marketing materials are produced on time, within budget and aligned to business priorities.
- Support depot-led campaigns and local marketing activity, creating effective collateral and tools that help generate leads and grow customer accounts.
- Act as the marketing lead for Product Expos and Mock Depot initiatives, providing marketing materials and event support where required.
- Create clear and engaging communications for depots, ensuring marketing activity is understood, implemented effectively and aligned with wider business objectives.
- Champion brand consistency across all local marketing activity, ensuring communications and materials reflect our brand guidelines and high standards.
- Analyse the performance of local marketing activity, using data and insights to measure impact and shape future marketing strategies.
- Build strong relationships across marketing, trade and category teams, establishing effective ways of working and driving successful cross-functional collaboration.
- Support wider marketing projects and business initiatives, contributing ideas, expertise and leadership to help deliver strategic objectives.

What do we need from you?
- Proven experience in marketing within a B2 B or trade environment
- Confidence in managing local marketing campaigns, POS activity, and event execution
- Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders and deadlines
- Experience of managing agency, partnership, relationships
- A proactive, solutions-focused mindset - ready to adapt to changing business priorities
- Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the ability to engage teams across all levels
- A collaborative approach and willingness to travel nationally when needed
- Passion for brand consistency and creating marketing that truly delivers impact

About Howdens:
Howdens Joinery is a highly successful FTSE 100 business, with more than 900 depots nationwide and more than 11,000 staff. Last year our sales reached circa 2.3bn, and we continue to experience significant growth and success. Despite our scale, Howdens remains a local business with traditional values.
There is a strong entrepreneurial ethos and the opportunity to develop within a fast-paced and commercial environment. That, along with a competitive salary, development opportunities, and exciting rewards, are among the reasons why our people enjoy working for Howdens - and why we have been named one of the 10 Best Big Companies to Work For.

Howdens is founded on the principle of being Worthwhile for ALL concerned. We're working hard to ensure we provide an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome. We will do everything we can to support you during your application. If you need us to make any adjustments to our recruitment process, please email with the job title and location, and we will be happy to help you.

Please note that candidates applying for this role must have a valid right to work in the UK, we do not offer sponsorship of employment for any depot positions at this time. We appreciate your understanding.

title: Marketing Executive
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Marketing Executive - Join a Growing, Creative, High-Impact Team
Location: Office-based 4 days per week (WFH Fridays)
Hours: Full-time, (finish at 2.30pm every Friday)
Salary: £35,000
Contract: Permanent

360 Campaigns - Newsletters - Social Media - Publication - Market - Lead Generation - Reports - Content Generation -

This is a busy, hands-on role for someone who enjoys a dynamic environment. From implementing and analysing 360 marketing campaigns - from newsletters and social media to SEO, PPC, and everything in between - you will be the go-to marketing professional for all things digital and print. You will also have the opportunity to coordinate both global and local events.

Do you have a good eye for social media? We're looking for a candidate who can create engaging posts that go beyond impressions and drive meaningful engagement with our audiences.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join our first UK-based marketing team in the heart of Northamptonshire. If you work in digital marketing and can support our Head of Marketing in creating and growing campaigns, this could be the perfect role for you!

About the Job

We attribute a large part of our growth to being found online by customers through marketing, and this continues to be a driving force behind our business. To help generate leads and support our future growth plans, we're now looking for a highly ambitious Marketing Executive to join us.

Key Parts of the Role

Content and graphic creation: Producing content and graphics that align with the brand across social media, websites, Google Ads, and more
- PPC experience

Keyword research: Conducting keyword research to identify relevant, high-traffic keywords across different markets, products, competitors, and audiences
Internet business analysis: Day-to-day, you will work across our international markets (UK, EU, and Rest of World excluding the USA), focusing on campaign planning optimisation, creation, and execution
Print marketing: Creating corporate designs for banners, flyers, display stands, and more
Performance measurement: Monitoring ROI, CTAs, gated content, traffic, and conversions
A/B testing: Conducting A/B tests to determine the most effective ad copy, keywords, and targeting strategies

What we're looking for in you
Our next Marketing Executive should already understand campaign-driven marketing strategy.
We're also open to either agency or in-house experience, but what's important is that you'll come with a passion for us and what you do. Digital Marketing is critical to gaining new customers and growing our brand globally.

About You:
Strong background and proven track record in marketing campaigns with an agency or in-house
- PPC

Multilingual ad campaigns
Strong analytical skills will be essential and have second-to-none communication skills and attention to detail.
Adobe Creative Suite including Photoshop, InDesign, and Adobe Illustrator
Able to operate at both a strategic and tactical level with a blend of analytical, creative, and numerical skills
Be able to thrive in a data-driven environment
Excellent stakeholder management
Ability to work to deadlines, manage multiple projects and react quickly to changing business priorities

Essential Skills

Commercial Awareness: Presenting clear, data-backed business cases to improve efficiency & drive new customer acquisition
Growth: Contribute to achieving the acquisition, revenue, and customer LTV targets across key markets
Processes: Build and develop efficient processes and workflows
Branding: Ensure unified messaging and consistent branding across all marketing channels and communications
Communication: Confidently and clearly communicate your chosen search strategies, optimisation techniques and results to all stakeholders

Company Benefits:

Flexible working hours
Friday working from home
Annual leave 25 days plus bank holidays
Team trips to marketing conferences
Free fresh fruit and hot drinks
Company claims back scheme on various health services
Company pension scheme
Free Parking

If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.

Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and employment business for the supply of temporary workers. By applying for this job you accept the T&C's, Privacy Policy and Disclaimers which can be found at hays.co.uk

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Marketing Executive
Hybrid Full Time Permanent
About the Employer
An established UK technology business providing IT infrastructure, data protection, disaster recovery and enterprise technology solutions to organisations across a range of sectors. Working closely with leading global technology vendors, the company combines specialist technical expertise with long-standing industry experience to help customers protect, manage and modernise business-critical IT environments.
The Role
An exciting opportunity has arisen for a hands-on Marketing Executive to join a growing B2 B technology marketing team. This practical, delivery-focused position will play an important role in turning marketing strategies into effective, measurable campaigns across digital channels.
Working closely with marketing, sales and SDR colleagues, you will build and manage campaigns in HubSpot, create landing pages and email sequences, develop marketing assets, support PPC and social media activity, and monitor campaign performance. This is an excellent opportunity for an organised marketer looking to develop their expertise in B2 B technology, campaign management and digital marketing.
Duties & Responsibilities
- Build and manage integrated marketing campaigns in HubSpot, including emails, landing pages, forms, lists, workflows and associated campaign assets.
- Maintain and organise the HubSpot portal to ensure campaigns, marketing assets, data and reporting remain accurate and consistent.
- Produce campaign reports and dashboards, monitoring marketing performance against agreed KPIs and objectives.
- Create professional landing pages, email campaigns and marketing resources in line with established brand and editorial guidelines.
- Plan, create and publish engaging social media content, particularly for LinkedIn, while supporting paid digital and PPC campaigns.
- Collaborate with marketing, SDR and sales teams to understand briefs and deliver both long-term campaigns and fast-turnaround marketing projects.
- Create and adapt visual marketing assets using Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud applications, while supporting website content development and management.
- Support channel and co-marketing campaigns with major technology vendors and strategic partners.

Education & Skills Required
- A degree in marketing or a related discipline, or an equivalent professional marketing qualification such as CIM, would be advantageous.
- Previous marketing experience, ideally within B2 B IT, technology or a channel environment such as a vendor, reseller, MSP or technology partner.
- Strong HubSpot skills covering campaign creation, management, automation, organisation, reporting and performance measurement.
- Experience creating professional landing pages, email campaigns, digital marketing content and associated campaign assets.
- Working knowledge of Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud, combined with excellent written and spoken English and strong attention to detail.
- An organised, collaborative and dependable approach, with the ability to manage varied workloads, meet deadlines and communicate effectively with sales, SDR and marketing stakeholders. Applicants must have the right to work in the UK.
- Hybrid.
- Monday to Friday, 8:30am to 5:30pm.
- Banbury.
- Salary: 30 k to 35 k. (Depending on experience)
If you are an enthusiastic and detail-focused Marketing Executive looking to develop your career within the B2 B technology sector, this is an excellent opportunity to take ownership of meaningful campaigns and expand your digital marketing expertise. Apply today to take the next step in your marketing career.
For a discreet, detailed discussion about the role, you can reach out to Vanessa Rodriguez at (phone number removed) or email (url removed)

title: Sales & Marketing Executive
description:
Corby, Northamptonshire

28,000 - 30,000 + bonus & benefits

Overview:

This well-established business who work with customers in a range of industries is looking to appoint an ambitious, driven Sales & Marketing Executive. Working closely with the Head of Commercial, you will get fantastic experience across both sales and marketing and develop skills that will lead to rapid progression in your career.

This is a varied role with involvement in the whole process across marketing, sales and customer interaction. The split of the role will broadly be around 60% sales to 40% marketing but this will change depending on what the business needs at a given time.

Key Responsibilities:
- Play a key role throughout the customer journey from creation and positioning of tailored marketing outputs to dealing with customer enquiries through to orders.
- Talk with customers to understand their requirements and work with internal colleagues to respond to these and develop solutions and close orders.
- Work with the Head of Commercial to deliver the company's marketing strategy.
- Help to create engaging marketing content across social media and other digital platforms as well as more traditional marketing channels.
- Follow up on quotations that have been sent to customers and help to maintain a healthy and accurate sales pipeline.
- Work closely with the Operations team to make sure that customer orders are on schedule.
- Monitor marketing activity and track engagement and results.

The Person:
- Energetic, positive and keen to learn with a proactive attitude.
- Previous sales, marketing, customer service or customer-facing experience would be beneficial.
- A really good grasp of social media and an understanding of what kind of content and style of content drives engagement.
- Good attention to detail and organisational skills and able to work on multiple projects at any one time.
- Able to work with figures, pricings and quotations.
- Confident communicating with colleagues in the business and external customers.
- Ambitious with a desire to develop a career not just a job. This role offers genuine progression in a business that is going places.

title: Social Media Assistant (Part Time)
description:
Social Media Assistant (Part Time)

Berzerk Active Play Trilogy Active
8 Hours per Week
SCP 24 (Pro Rata)

Help us inspire active lifestyles through social media

Do you love creating content, spotting social media trends, and engaging with online communities?

We're looking for a creative and enthusiastic Social Media Assistant to help bring the Berzerk Active Play brand to life across TikTok and Instagram. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys creating engaging content, keeping up with trends, and helping grow a brand's online presence.

Whether you're studying, looking for additional hours, building a career in marketing, or simply passionate about social media, we'd love to hear from you.

About Trilogy Active

At Trilogy Active, our mission is simple:

Inspiring Active Lifestyles

We are a charity and social enterprise dedicated to improving the wellbeing of people across our communities through sport, physical activity, health and wellbeing opportunities.

Everything we do is guided by our values:
- One Trilogy Team
- Encourage Creativity
- Be Constructive
- Deliver Excellence
- Promote Wellbeing
- Embrace Diversity

What you'll be doing

As our Social Media Assistant, you'll support the growth of Berzerk Active Play's online presence by:
- Creating engaging content for TikTok and Instagram
- Identifying and responding to current social media trends
- Supporting the delivery of the social media content plan
- Monitoring and responding to comments and messages across social media channels
- Attending monthly planning meetings with the Marketing Communications Officer
- Producing simple monthly reports on social media performance, engagement and reach
- Helping generate new ideas to grow our audience and increase engagement

What we're looking for

We're looking for someone who is:
- Passionate about social media and content creation
- Creative with an eye for detail
- Confident using TikTok and Instagram
- Enthusiastic, motivated and proactive
- Comfortable communicating with people online
- Open to learning and trying new ideas
- A positive team player who enjoys working with others
- Flexible and willing to travel between Trilogy Active and Berzerk Active Play sites when required

Why join us?

At Trilogy Active you'll be part of an organisation that genuinely cares about people, wellbeing and community impact. You'll have the opportunity to develop your social media and marketing skills while helping inspire more people to get active and have fun.

If you're creative, full of ideas and excited by the power of social media, we'd love to hear from you.

Join us and help inspire active lifestyles.

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Northampton
